priya_runtime: Kicking off kernel v2.4 + quant-profile 'sparse-ptq-v3' canary in pool A. Window Tue 10:00-11:00 PT. Claiming slot A3. Who's owning smoke verification and rollback readiness?

alex_dev: I can own smoke checks. I'll run perf + regen + kvcache sanity. Which test set should I use?

priya_runtime: Use chat-smoke-20 for correctness and perf-smoke for latency. Command: ```./smoke/run.sh --profile=sparse-ptq-v3 --tests chat-smoke-20,perf-smoke```

chen_infra: I'll watch infra metrics (GPU temps, evictions, node pressure). Ping me at start and I'll tail node exporter + kube events. I'll also ensure autoscaler budgets look good.

jamie_sre: I'll prep rollback steps and verify runbook. Rollback plan: revert routing -> scale to kernel-v2.3 -> clear kv cache if needed. Runbook RB-84. Note: we need --force-clear-kvcache flag if we see inconsistent logits after switch.

alex_dev: quick heads-up: this quant profile uses g4/group-size=64. Watch for memory pressure on long sequences (>1024). I'll set pod OOM alerts to high sensitivity.

priya_runtime: thanks. Deploy will start at :10:00PT. alex_dev, please post smoke command outputs here. chen_infra, jamie_sre, jive if you spot anything abnormal. @deploy-bot will post slot assignment. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy initiated by priya_runtime at 1934567020 — canary slot A3 assigned to priya_runtime. CI status: all green.

alex_dev: smoke run started 1934567050. Logs: perf p90 +7% (expected), regen pass 19/20 (one minor token mismatch on prompt #12). kvcache checks OK. Pasting tail: ```[kvcache] miss_rate=0.003, errors=0```

chen_infra: infra looks stable. No GPU evictions, temps steady ~72C, node CPU spike during load but within threshold. Kube events: no OOMs.

jamie_sre: rollback checklist complete. PR #4821 merged for rollback automation. Verified traffic shift script works locally: `./scripts/shift-traffic --from=canary --to=fallback --dry-run`

priya_runtime: canary metrics after 12m: error rate unchanged, latency p95 up 10ms, throughput OK. regen failure was non-deterministic; re-ran prompt #12 and passed. Planning to roll to pool B in 15m unless objections.

alex_dev: run endpoint tests now: `/v1/generate?model=kernel-v2.4` -> golden prompt set passed. No new regressions.

chen_infra: go for pool B. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler and rack-level temps during B rollout.

jamie_sre: :thumbsup: standby on rollback commands, but looks clear.

priya_runtime: moving to pool B at +15m. I'll update if anything flips. Thanks everyone for quick checks.
